description: This Dart source file defines the SocialRepository class responsible for managing user profiles and friends data in a mock, in-memory manner for a social feature within a Flutter mobile application. It provides methods to fetch, update, search, add, and remove friends and user profiles, simulating real backend interactions with placeholder logic.

classes.name: SocialRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing user profile and friends data with mock fallback behavior

methods.name: updateMyProfile
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with new display name and bio.

methods.name: getFriends
methods.description: Retrieves the list of friends, with a slight randomness to simulate online status fluctuations.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users by name, returning matching entries from a predefined candidate list.

methods.name: addFriend
methods.description: Adds a new friend to the friends list, if not already present.

methods.name: removeFriend
methods.description: Removes a friend from the list based on user ID.
